messages:
maria: Quick sync  we need the social rollout for the webinar (Serving Inference Economics). Deliverables: X thread (4 tweets), LinkedIn post, hero PNG (1200x627), 15s promo MP4, UTMs and HubSpot routing. Can we lock assets by Fri EOD?
linda: I can own the X thread + LinkedIn copy. Plan: announce (Apr 9), reminder (Apr 11), last-call (Apr 15). A/B test two X openers.
josh: Draft hooks: 1) "Cut inference cost by 3x without swapping models. Webinar Apr 17 -> [landing]" 2) "Same model, lower cost: practical ops tricks. Join our engineers -> [landing]" 3) LinkedIn opener: "Serving LLMs is an ops problem. We ran benchmarks you can reuse. Thread below."
priya: UTM plan: utm_source=x|linkedin, utm_medium=social, utm_campaign=serving_inference_v1, utm_term=startup|enterprise. I'll create landing variants: /webinar/serving?variant=startup and ?variant=enterprise to route to different workflows.
sam (SDR): HubSpot list: webinar_serving_inference. Routing: round-robin to SDR - Growth. Spike rule: titles containing "VP"/"Director" flagged high-intent and assigned to kevin. Follow-up templates: auto-email on register, high-intent outreach within 24h, no-show nurture 3 days later.
leo (Design): Can deliver hero PNG + 15s clip by Thu 5pm if I get a one-sentence script and slide title today. Will post Figma link here.
buffer-bot: Drafts created in Buffer for Apr 9 09:00, Apr 11 09:00, Apr 15 08:00 PST (pending approval).
maria: Approval checklist: josh final copy Thu 3pm, leo deliverables Thu 5pm, priya UTMs + HubSpot Fri 9am, sam SDR templates Fri 10am, linda schedule Buffer posts after approvals. Ping this thread when done.
linda: I'll also prepare two creative variants for the A/B test (stat-centric vs. ROI-centric).
priya: I'll add hidden fields on the form for utm_campaign and variant so we can tag properly. Also will wire Zap: new registrant -> create HubSpot contact + add to list + Slack notify #sales-inbound.
maria: Great. Once assets are in i'll approve in Buffer and well launch the A/B. Thanks team :thumbsup:
